summary: Computes MPEG audio buffer/timing parameters on an audio object: derives buffer size (768x or 2304x channel multiplier depending on the mono flag at +0x2490), timing quotient/remainder from 28800 x (5 x mode multiplier at +0x2494) divided by the sample rate at +0x2484, stores sample_rate/100, sets an initial timing field and the ready flag to 1, then copies the computed buffer size into +0x249C. Returns constant 0. Called during decoder-open paths by CMpegBase_Open and CMpegFilePlayer_Open.

local_names.this[2339]: field +0x248C, computed buffer size (768 x or 2304 x channel multiplier)
local_names.this[2340]: field +0x2490, mono-mode flag; == 1 selects 768x buffer size
local_names.this[2341]: field +0x2494, mode multiplier, used as 5x in the timing calculation

local_names.this[2357]: field +0x24D4, initial timing field set to 1
local_names.this[2358]: field +0x24D8, timing quotient (28800 x 5x mode / sample rate)
local_names.this[2359]: field +0x24DC, timing remainder, fractional part scaled by /100

operations.description: Read the sample rate at +0x2484 into v1; it is the divisor for the timing quotient/remainder and for +0x24E0
Compute v2 = 5 x value at +0x2494 (mode multiplier); the 5x factor is used in both timing expressions
Set +0x24D8 = (28800 x v2) / v1: timing quotient from the sample rate
Set +0x24DC = ((28800 x v2) % v1) / 100: fractional timing remainder, scaled down by 100
Read byte at +0x2490 and test == 1: mono-mode flag selects the buffer-size multiplier
Read +0x24CC (channel multiplier) into v4; it scales the buffer size
Set +0x24E0 = v1 / 100: sample rate scaled down
Guarded on the +0x2490 mono flag: if == 1 set buffer size +0x248C = 768 x v4, else 2304 x v4 (stereo)
Copy the computed buffer size from +0x248C into +0x249C
Return constant 0 unconditionally; no failure path is evidenced
